Requirements:
clean_data and obstacle_df
(read from read_data.R)

Library
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
```

Find if route goes left or right of each obstacle
```{r}
visibility_levels <- c(25, 30, 40, 55, 150)

trial_id <- interaction(
  clean_data$ID,
  clean_data$Trial_Number,
  clean_data$Config_Number,
  clean_data$visibility,
  drop = TRUE
)

trial_list <- split(clean_data, trial_id)

trial_sides_list <- lapply(trial_list, function(traj) {
  
  config_num <- as.numeric(
    as.character(traj$Config_Number[1])
  )
  obstacles <- configurations_list[[config_num]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Z_Pos > 0.1,
      Z_Pos < 125
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      obstacle_id = dplyr::row_number()
    )
  player_x <- sapply(
    obstacles$Z_Pos,
    function(z) {
      
      closest_point <- which.min(
        abs(traj$Z_Pos - z)
      )
      traj$X_Pos[closest_point]
    }
  )
  
  data.frame(
    ID = traj$ID[1],
    Trial_Number = traj$Trial_Number[1],
    Config_Number = config_num,
    visibility = as.numeric(
      as.character(traj$visibility[1])
    ),
    obstacle_id = obstacles$obstacle_id,
    side = ifelse(
      player_x < obstacles$X_Pos,
      0,   # left
      1    # right
    )
  )
})

trial_sides <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  trial_sides_list
)
```

Formatting for plots
```{r}
clusters_plot <- trial_sides %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    ID,
    Trial_Number,
    Config_Number,
    visibility,
    obstacle_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    ID,
    Trial_Number,
    Config_Number,
    visibility
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    path = paste(side, collapse = ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Stable route IDs across visibility conditions (so the same color shows for different visibilities)
clusters_plot <- clusters_plot %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Config_Number) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cluster = dplyr::dense_rank(path)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  # Frequency remains specific to each condition
  dplyr::group_by(Config_Number, visibility, Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster_n = dplyr::n()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
```


Plot 1a: cluster number by visibility and config
```{r}
n_clusters <- clusters_plot %>%
  
  # Remove low-frequency clusters
  dplyr::filter(cluster_n >= 5) %>%
  # One row for each high-frequency cluster
  dplyr::distinct(
    Config_Number,
    visibility,
    Cluster
  ) %>%
  # Count hf clusters
  dplyr::count(
    Config_Number,
    visibility,
    name = "n_clusters"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Config_Number = 1:10,
    visibility = c(25, 30, 40, 55, 150),
    fill = list(n_clusters = 0)
  )

# Plot
cluster_number_plot <- ggplot(
  n_clusters,
  aes(
    x = factor(visibility),
    y = n_clusters
  )
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Config_Number,
    nrow = 2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "# of \"High-Frequency\" Route Clusters by Visibility",
    x = "Visibility (m)",
    y = "Number of Clusters"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)
  ) 

cluster_number_plot
```

Plot 1b: combined line plot
```{r}
cluster_number_summary <- n_clusters %>%
  dplyr::group_by(visibility) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_clusters = mean(n_clusters),
    se_clusters = sd(n_clusters) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_number_line_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = n_clusters,
    aes(
      x = visibility,
      y = n_clusters,
      color = factor(Config_Number),
      group = Config_Number
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = n_clusters,
    aes(
      x = visibility,
      y = n_clusters,
      color = factor(Config_Number)
    )
  ) +
  geom_errorbar( #+- 1 SE
    data = cluster_number_summary,
    aes(
      x = visibility,
      ymin = mean_clusters - se_clusters,
      ymax = mean_clusters + se_clusters
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = cluster_number_summary,
    aes(x = visibility, y = mean_clusters)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cluster_number_summary,
    aes(x = visibility, y = mean_clusters)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = visibility_levels) +
  labs(
    title = "High-Frequency Route Clusters by Visibility",
    x = "Visibility (m)",
    y = "Number of Clusters",
    color = "Configuration"
  )

cluster_number_line_plot

```

Plot 2a: number of low-frequency routes
```{r}
outlier_counts <- clusters_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    cluster_n < 5
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Config_Number,
    visibility,
    name = "n_outliers"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Config_Number = 1:10,
    visibility = visibility_levels,
    fill = list(n_outliers = 0)
  )

# Plot low-frequency trajectories
outlier_plot <- ggplot(
  outlier_counts,
  aes(
    x = factor(visibility),
    y = n_outliers,
    group = 1
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Config_Number,
    nrow = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "# of \"Low-Frequency\" Trajectories by Visibility",
    x = "Visibility (m)",
    y = "Number of Low-Frequency Trajectories"
  ) 

outlier_plot
```

Plot 3: actual trajectories
```{r}
# Add cluster information to trajectory data
traj_clusters <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    clusters_plot %>%
      dplyr::select(
        ID, Trial_Number, Config_Number, visibility,
        Cluster, cluster_n
      ),
    by = c("ID", "Trial_Number", "Config_Number", "visibility")
  )


# Make one 2 x 5 plot for each configuration
for (c in 1:10) {
  
  regular <- traj_clusters %>%
    dplyr::filter(Config_Number == c, cluster_n >= 5) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(type = "Clusters")
  
  low_freq <- traj_clusters %>%
    dplyr::filter(Config_Number == c, cluster_n < 5) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(type = "Low frequency")
  
  obstacles <- configurations_list[[c]]

  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_path(
      data = regular,
      aes(
        X_Pos, Z_Pos,
        group = interaction(ID, Trial_Number),
        color = factor(Cluster)
      ),
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_path(
      data = low_freq,
      aes(
        X_Pos, Z_Pos,
        group = interaction(ID, Trial_Number)
      ),
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = obstacles,
      aes(X_Pos, Z_Pos),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      type ~ visibility
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Configuration", c),
      x = "X Position",
      y = "Z Position",
      color = "Cluster"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  print(p)
}
```
